sentences.text: On 14 March a configuration change to the payment router sent most card traffic to a single processor that was already close to its limit, and checkout failed for 71 minutes for roughly 38 percent of customers.
sentences.subject: Postmortem: the checkout outage of 14 March

sentences.text: The change was safe in isolation but interacted with a retry setting that multiplied the load on that processor within seconds.
sentences.subject: weighting change

sentences.text: We lost an estimated 412,000 euros in orders that did not come back, and no customer data was exposed.
sentences.subject: Impact

sentences.text: The incident was detected by a customer-facing alert rather than by our own monitoring. ## Impact
sentences.subject: customer-facing alert

sentences.text: Between 09:12 and 10:23 UTC, 38 percent of checkout attempts returned an error, concentrated in the three largest markets.
sentences.subject: Impact

sentences.text: The mobile apps failed more often than the web site, because they retry aggressively and made the throttling worse.
sentences.subject: mobile apps

sentences.text: About 9,100 customers contacted support during the incident, roughly four times the usual volume.
sentences.subject: support contacts

sentences.text: Refunds for double charges were completed by the following Monday. ## Timeline
sentences.subject: support contacts

sentences.text: At 09:04 a routine change moved the card router to a new weighting that favoured the cheapest processor.
sentences.subject: weighting change

sentences.text: At 09:12 error rates on checkout began to climb.
sentences.subject: Timeline

sentences.text: At 09:31 a customer-facing alert from the support tooling, not our own monitoring, told the incident commander that something was wrong.
sentences.subject: customer-facing alert

sentences.text: At 09:40 the team rolled back the weighting change, but errors did not fall.
sentences.subject: rollback

sentences.text: At 09:58 an engineer noticed that the retry queue held more than two million pending requests.
sentences.subject: retry queue

sentences.text: At 10:11 the team drained the queue and manually pinned traffic to the second processor, and errors fell within minutes.
sentences.subject: retry queue

sentences.text: At 10:23 checkout returned to normal, and the incident was closed at 10:50. ## Root cause
sentences.subject: Timeline

sentences.text: The root cause was an unbounded retry policy in the payment router, which resends a failed request immediately and without a limit.
sentences.subject: unbounded retry policy

sentences.text: When the cheapest processor began throttling, every rejected request came straight back, so the load we sent grew faster than the processor's limit, and the throttling got worse instead of better.
sentences.subject: unbounded retry policy

sentences.text: The weighting change was the trigger but not the cause, because any slowdown at that processor would have produced the same spiral.
sentences.subject: weighting change

sentences.text: Rolling the change back did not help because the queue of retries kept the pressure up on its own. ## Contributing factors
sentences.subject: rollback

sentences.text: Our monitoring watched error rates per market but not retry queue depth, so the signal that mattered most was invisible.
sentences.subject: monitoring

sentences.text: The page went to a muted channel, which cost us about twelve minutes of response time.
sentences.subject: muted channel

sentences.text: A load test had been run for the new weighting, but it simulated a slow processor and not a throttling one.
sentences.subject: load test

sentences.text: The runbook for the router had not been updated since the previous quarter. ## What went well
sentences.subject: Contributing factors

sentences.text: The incident commander declared a major incident within minutes of the alert and kept a written log.
sentences.subject: What went well

sentences.text: The second processor was already integrated, so pinning traffic to it took one command.
sentences.subject: second processor

sentences.text: We found out from a customer-facing alert and not from our own monitoring.
sentences.subject: customer-facing alert

sentences.text: The rollback was the wrong first move, and it cost nearly half an hour.
sentences.subject: rollback

sentences.text: We were also unlucky that two of the three people who know the router were out that day. ## Action items -
sentences.subject: Contributing factors

sentences.text: Cap retries in the payment router at three attempts with exponential backoff, owned by the payments team and due by 28 March. -
sentences.subject: retry cap

sentences.text: Add retry queue depth to the dashboards and alert on it, due by 31 March. -
sentences.subject: monitoring

sentences.text: Audit every muted paging channel and require a quarterly review of the routing, due by 11 April. -
sentences.subject: muted channel

sentences.text: Extend load tests to cover throttling as well as slowness, due by the end of April. -
sentences.subject: load test

sentences.text: The retry cap is the one that would have prevented this incident, and it ships first. ## Related links - Incident ticket and chat log. - Payment router design document. - Previous postmortem: webhook backlog, January.
sentences.subject: retry cap
